exposure: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) control (poor vs. good)
Postload plasma glucose (PPG) control (poor vs. good)
cohort: 997 singleton pregnancy patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Poor control of both FPG and PPG were independently associated with increased odds of HDCP.
mod_finding: Poor PPG control was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery, while good PPG control was associated with an increased risk of PROM.
